scripts.build: tsc -b packages/vite-plugin-vue-transient && bun run --cwd packages/editor build && tsc -b
scripts.type-check: bun check && bun run --cwd packages/editor type-check
scripts.test: bun test src/ && bun run --cwd packages/editor test:e2e
scripts.verify: biome ci --error-on-warnings && bun run build && bun run type-check && bun run test
